hook: Porat oversees Alphabet's capital allocation as President and Chief Investment Officer, a role she has held since September 2023 after eight years as the company's Chief Financial Officer. She sets the budget behind Alphabet's data center and AI infrastructure buildout, including the equity and debt financing that supports it.
name: Ruth Porat
